# LLMReady

> An open-source AI compatibility auditor. Classify a site into one of six profiles, sample up to eight pages, then validate /llms.txt, RFC 9309 robots.txt, static HTML signal-to-noise and profile-specific schema.org metadata.

## Start here

- [Home](/): What LLMReady checks, how the score works and how to run an audit.
- [Audit workspace](/app): Classify a site, run the 49-check audit matrix against a deterministic page sample and inspect line-level fixes.
- [OpenAPI description](/openapi.json): OpenAPI 3.1 schema for `GET /api/audit`.
- [Expanded context](/llms-full.txt): The full audit model in one request.
- [Sitemap](/sitemap.xml): Canonical pages on this deployment.
- [Robots policy](/robots.txt): RFC 9309 rules with named AI crawler groups.
- [API catalog](/.well-known/api-catalog): RFC 9727 linkset pointing at the OpenAPI description.

## Product

- [CLI](/#cli): Run the same audit from a terminal with table, JSON, markdown or summary output and CI-friendly exit codes.
- [GitHub Action](/#action): Audit a deployment on every pull request, keep one sticky report comment current and fail below a score or grade threshold.
- [Site score vs page score](/#faq): The origin-scoped score, deterministic sampling and the `scope=page` fallback.
- [Site classification](/#pipeline): The six profiles and the signals behind them, with manual override.
- [Scoring model](/#faq): The checks the audit enforces, with pass conditions.

## Standards (external)

- [llms.txt specification](https://llmstxt.org/): The manifest structure this project validates.
- [RFC 9309](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9309): Robots Exclusion Protocol.
- [schema.org](https://schema.org/): Structured data vocabularies used by the audit.

## Project (external)

- [Source code](https://github.com/ABradwell/llm-seo-toolbox): GPL-3.0-only.
- [Issues](https://github.com/ABradwell/llm-seo-toolbox/issues): Report a bug or request a check.
- [Contributing](https://github.com/ABradwell/llm-seo-toolbox/blob/main/README.md#contributing): Run the full validation suite before opening a PR.
- [Deploy on Vercel](https://vercel.com/new/clone?repository-url=https%3A%2F%2Fgithub.com%2FABradwell%2Fllm-seo-toolbox): One-click deployment.
